verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's SFU pricing docs give a recurring free allowance: the first 1,000 GB each month is free. Published (ingress) traffic is free, and TURN is free when used with the SFU, which comfortably covers development and early testing. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the free allowance, documentation of any free allowance for RealtimeKit (prebuilt SDK, recording, transcription) usage.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: The first 1,000 GB each month is free.
Traffic published into Cloudflare is free, including when no client subscribes to that publication.
Using Cloudflare Realtime TURN service is available free of charge when used together with the Realtime SFU.
